rationale: User ruling 2026-09-18: put the tiebreak lane (秤砣线) live and pause every other strategy -- closed, not deleted. A paused lane still compiles, records its decisions and writes the evidence the ledger and the fits read; only its sends are held (basket BUYs end failed with strategy_lane_paused:basket on their event; the two sell lanes are skipped by the daemon). Read fresh before every send. Missing file = every lane enabled; unreadable file = every lane paused. Charters 146, 163, 166 and 175. The far-tail lane (tail_short) keeps running beside it: another lane's acknowledged rung on a different bucket no longer holds its takes back.

tiebreak.note: 秤砣线 v2.3 (charter 175, user ruling 2026-09-21 「把价带上限改成按实付价 ≤0.60」): at a stage's first decision, the model's mode bucket priced at least 0.40 by the market's normalised mid AND quoted both sides at most 3 cents wide -> rest one post-only GTD rung on that bucket at the best bid plus one tick (clamped under the ask), stake_usdc' worth of shares, once per station-day -- and only if that rung's own price is at most max_paid_price (0.60). The ceiling used to be on the normalised mid, which sits a median 3 cents under the price paid: the four P0-M fills bought at 0.61-0.66 settled 0/4. v2.2 (charter 163, 2026-09-20..21) had the same conditions with the ceiling on the mid; each rule version is its own sample. Features (market move since the previous decision, spread, depth) are recorded on every evaluation row, not traded on. A send the VENUE turned away because the market was not trading ("trading is disabled") spends none of max_sends_per_station_day; those attempts have their own budget and an hour between tries (user ruling 2026-09-20 「改」). Charter 229 (user rulings 2026-09-26 「p0m和p1仅限秤砣线策略开仓」「P0 只留篮子」): the lane opens only on the first decisions of the stages in opening_stages (P0-M, P1). A P0 first decision is still scored into tiebreak_lane_evaluation and, fired, refused stage_not_opening:P0 -- never sent, never retried.

p1_tail.note: P1 尾段线 v1 (charter 166, user ruling 2026-09-20 「上线尾段车道 p1_tail 策略」): on a P1 envelope whose own likelihood receipt puts the report 6 to 10 hours from this station's settlement clock, the belief is the market's normalised mid ladder masked by the hard observed bound and multiplied by that envelope's served observation likelihood; where that belief clears the best ask by 8 cents the lane crosses FOK for stake_usdc' worth, one bucket once ever, at most max_sends_per_station_day a day. Measured 2026-09-20 over 09-05..09-19: +0.166 per dollar at the report plus two minutes, +0.138 at five, +0.077 at eight with a lower bound through zero; outside the bin negative or absent. The bin was chosen after seeing the result and only 09-18/19 are days no selection saw, so the lane ships at 5 USDC and keeps every evaluation. A take is priced on the newest snapshot and arrives later, so book_fresh_seconds bounds what may be SCORED and send_book_fresh_seconds (60s) what may be BOUGHT, and a take never asks for the whole top level. The limit may walk walk_ticks above the best ask (the top level is too thin to fill a 5 USDC take most of the time), and the hurdle is then tested against that walked price rather than the ask. Conflicts with the tiebreak lane: never the same bucket, never queued behind a resting BUY of any lane, separate evaluation table and intent prefix. The committed snapshot is a cycle's batch (a median 331s old when the lane read it, 48 of 50 fired envelopes refused send_book_stale), so when it is older than send_book_fresh_seconds the lane scores and prices on the WS publisher's own manifest for that station-day, seconds old; live_ws_book false turns that off (2026-09-21, 「为什么P1 尾段线没有发单」). The 6-10h bin is read on hours_axis: remaining_hours (the hours left to the settlement clock, the axis the edge was measured on) and not on the receipt clock_hours, which adds the station peak offset of charter 157; replayed on books under five minutes old, +0.116/$ against +0.041 (2026-09-21, 「改」). Rule version p1_tail_lane_v2; clock_hours restores v1.
p1_tail.pause_note: User ruling 2026-09-23 「P1 尾段线：暂定交易先关闭」: 16 settled legs over 09-21/09-22, 5 hit, 71.26 USDC in, -43.95 (-61.7%); the seven bought under 0.50 all lost (-30.06), the nine at 0.50 or more hit 5 and still lost -13.89. Switched off at the lane file; the worker returns before calling the lane, so no new evaluations are written while it is off. Turn back on by setting enabled true.

p1_consensus.note: 同心线 (the P1 consensus lane, charter 203). v2 (user ruling 2026-09-23 「吃单改为post only。best买一+1，挂单周期改为最短，没成交继续挂！」): on a P1 decision 6-10 h from the settlement clock where the model's and the market's mode and mean buckets are one bucket and its best ask is in [0.50, 0.70), post one post-only GTD rung at the best bid plus one tick (5 USDC), signed at the venue's minimum horizon (~3.5 min), and re-post it on the current book while unfilled, as long as the decision's belief stands and the day is >= 6 h from its clock. At most 2 takes a station-day, 1 per bucket, 20 minutes apart; one rung resting at a time; no exclusion against the tiebreak lane. v1 (08:11Z-11:41Z) crossed FOK at the ask: LTAC 09-23 20°C, four takes. Replay 07-28..09-22 (at the ask): 117 takes, +15.3% [+4.8%, +25.3%].
p1_consensus.pause_note: User rulings 2026-09-26 「p0m和p1仅限秤砣线策略开仓」 then 「停同心线」 (charter 229): P1 openings belong to the tiebreak lane alone. Switched off at the lane file; the worker skips the lane while it is off (no new evaluations, no re-posts), and a rung still resting ends at its own ~3.5-minute horizon under the resting lifecycle. Turn back on with the board's 同心线 switch.

proper_bet.note: Proper 下注线 v2 (charter 231; user rulings 2026-09-26 「调整下注规则」「实盘上线，p＝天气模型」, then 「吃单改为挂单，post-only，best bid+1，挂单周期最短，重新挂单，直至成交，但是挂单价格要符合下注规则」「proper线还是按照>36h，仅p0阶段下单」「预算提高到最低要求」). At a P0 first decision with more than min_hours_to_settlement hours to the settlement clock: p = the served weather-model envelope that decision read, q = the market's normalised mid ladder on a book at most send_book_fresh_seconds old (the WS publisher's own ladder first). s_k = log(p_k/q_k); s>0 is a YES leg, s<0 a NO leg. Each leg is a post-only GTD rung at the best bid plus one tick of its own side's book (NO = the YES book mirrored: NO bid 1-YES ask, NO ask 1-YES bid), signed at the venue's minimum horizon and re-posted on the book that stands until its target fills -- and only at a price under its claim (YES under p_k, NO under 1-p_k). x_k = lambda*|s_k| shares with lambda the minimum the venue allows for the whole position (the smallest leg at 5 shares); when the free cash cannot carry it, the longest |s|-ordered prefix whose own minimum it can. A plan stops when the station-day leaves P0, falls to 36 h or less from its clock, closes, or is barred. v1 (FOK at the ask, 11:52Z-12:16Z) sent nothing. proper_bet_lane_evaluation keeps p, q, s, D, the plan and each leg's rungs; scripts/proper_bet_attribution.py closes Pi = dS + D - L on settlement. Measured before the ruling, two-sided Log shares: ROI -3.0% [-4.4, -1.7] at the ask; resting fills carry adverse selection (docs/research/log_proper_betting_20260926 sections 8-13). v3 (charter 249; user rulings 2026-10-03 「重开Proper 线并放开 YES，只开YES，市场众数桶，挂单」「限p0」): one leg a station-day -- YES on the market's own modal bucket (the largest normalised mid, the lower rung on a tie), rested post-only at the best bid plus one tick, only under p, at the venue's five-share minimum (sized up to one dollar where the price is under 0.20). buckets: market_mode keeps that one bucket (all is charter 231's whole ladder); a leg off the mode is quoted and recorded not_market_mode, never posted. entry: latest_decision judges the station-day's newest P0 decision on every pass until a plan is made (first_decision judged only the first, inside its first hour, and refused 170 of 173 station-days first_decision_stale over 2026-09-26..30). Each re-post reads the newest P0 envelope's p and the standing book: the leg waits while its bucket is not the market's mode or the rung would not be under p. Measured (docs/research/proper_conditional_edge_20261003, section 14): +1.7c a share when only a trade-through fills, +2.8c when a lifted level fills, intervals reaching zero on the served record; the lane is the live measurement. v2's 468 intents of 2026-09-28 were 464 gateway refusals and one order that rested and filled. rung_horizon_seconds 900 (charter 249 (九), user ruling 2026-10-03 「加长」): a rung rests fifteen minutes before it expires and is re-posted, never past the 36-hour line; 0 is the venue's minimum, which left a rung on the book for about four minutes of a six-to-fifteen-minute cycle.

proper_bet.charter_265_note: Charter 265 (user rulings 2026-10-10 「加，并把这个研究结果写进宪章」「作为执行层的选桶、作为模型的分辨率和条件性」「并不一定是ECMWF家族，去研究一下其他家族」「改」): rule v4 -- charter 231's standard rule again, every bucket, both sides, x_k = lambda*|s_k|, resting at bid+1t of each leg's own side, with s = log(b_k/q_k) read off the realisation layer's belief b (charter 254) whose v2 fit carries the latest-run change of AIFS ENS, AIFS single and GEFS, freshness exp(-h/6); b is read at the plan and again at every re-post, and only under an admitted, current v2 fit (else the station-day waits belief:<state>). v3's YES-on-the-mode was a restriction fitted to a belief whose level had no resolution. Measured on the standard rule (docs/research/run_change_families_20261010 addendum 1): market-only b at the ask -6.2% [-11.3,-2.0]; b with the three changes +1.0% [-0.8,+2.7] at the ask, +2.2% [+1.0,+3.3] in the resting scenario (fills assumed). Under v4 a NO the lane bought is sold when the cluster seals it and nothing is bought back (charter 258's YES mirror stays the 01:54Z flip's).

copy_follow.take_only_note: Charter 257 补记 (user ruling 2026-10-09 「3+5」): model_margin 0.05 -> 0.03 and max_slippage 0.06 -> 0.15; take_only -- a follow is a FOK at or under the cap within take_window_seconds (1800) of the episode buy, or nothing; no resting rung; an episode whose take did not happen is not chased by the next. Replay 09-21..10-08 (16.9 d, C stations): 38 legs/day, 190 U/day, locked median 390 U peak 550 U, +6.3% +/-10.6% a leg.
copy_follow.note: Charter 257 (user ruling 2026-10-09 「开实盘，利用现有的跟单策略，但是我的资金量有限，如何跟单」): follow the eight-wallet cluster's FIRST taker buy of a bucket episode only, fixed stake_usdc per leg, daily budget max_daily_cost_usdc, legs ranked by our margin; admitted only at 12-48h to the event's local noon, on C stations, when our served P0/P0-M probability clears the source price by model_margin; the cap is min(source price + max_slippage, our p - model_margin); sells and merges are not mirrored (winners leave through the 0.998 recycle lane). Research: docs/research/benchmark_account_0x8fbd_20261008 rounds 7 and 10 -- +4.8c/share at a 2c cost, three weeks positive; backtest at B=40/L=5/K=8: +131.9 U over 15 days, worst day -17.9 U. Default off; the board switch is the operator's. v1 (source_positions_value_ratio_at_source_price_v1) remains selectable.
copy_follow.direction_tiers_note: Charter 266 (user rulings 2026-10-10 「落地三档」「动量和四特征模型：解耦出来，其他策略比如proper线也可以使用」): rule v3 keeps v2's first-taker episodes, 12-48h window, C stations and take-only, and stakes each leg off the shared direction signal (bayes_basket_target/direction_signal.py, read at the source trade's instant): ECMWF momentum agrees with the leg's side of the market mode -> stake_tiers.momentum_agrees x stake_usdc; else the four-feature model agrees and momentum is not against -> model_agrees; else v2's probability filter passes and neither is against -> probability; a leg either signal is against is skipped (direction_disagrees:*). The two direction tiers need no probability margin (cap = source price + max_slippage). Base stake 3 U (tiers 9/6/3 U) per the ruling; the stake dial stays the operator's. Cash-constrained replay 09-22..10-07 (start 355 U): 86-100% utilisation, +707..+727 U over 15 days vs +411..+428 U for v2 at the same utilisation, in-sample. Set rule back to cluster_taker_first_filtered_fixed_stake_v2 to roll back.
copy_follow.big_episode_note: Charter 266 addendum 1 (user ruling 2026-10-10 「大单增加预算」): an episode whose cluster taker buys within big_episode_window_seconds (60) of its first fill add up to big_episode_usdc (30 U) is staked big_episode_multiplier (2) times on top of its tier; fills the public tape delivers late top the leg up inside the take window.
